segments.comment: Three status lines with conditions and the optional weapon, armor and terrain fields. allmain.c newgame() calls flush_screen(1), whose bot() redraws every field (disp.botlx from docrt()), then bot() again (816-818). Nothing changed in between, so botl.c evaluate_and_notify_windowport() sends no field and no BL_FLUSH, and the legacy text shows the first pass's last row. The pauper's AC changes in u_init_skills_discoveries()'s find_ac(), so the welcome pline's flush sends BL_AC and render_status() redraws the conditions from their moved x over the optional fields.
